adjudication.rationale: In `handleNewBooking.ts`, `evt.destinationCalendar` is initialized as `eventType.destinationCalendar ? [..] : organizerUser.destinationCalendar ? [..] : null` (not `[]`). Later, for collective team events, the diff adds `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars);`. If both the event type and organizer have no destination calendar, `evt.destinationCalendar` is `null`, so the optional-chained `push` is skipped and the collected `teamDestinationCalendars` (from other hosts) are never added—dropping those calendars silently.
